_about: Recipe of the demo bench project laser-trigger (sim.demo). Values are inputs only: sim.demo computes every part value, verdict, schematic and solder step with bench_core (calc, pins via project.update, schematic, solder) and stores the results through project.create/project.update.
title: Laser trigger
notes: Demo project (simulated board sim://esp32s3-n16r8). The load current of 13 mA is an example value: measure your laser module or LED and calculate again.
Laser safety: use only a small, labelled low-power laser module, never look into the beam and never point it at people, animals, mirrors or windows. Try the circuit with an LED first.
C1 (10 µF) buffers the 5 V load supply at J2 (rule of thumb, not calculated). VBAT: a single Li-ion cell, at most 4.2 V; R3/R4 halve it for GPIO1.
